connect.title: How to connect
connect.subtitle: Pick your assistant for setup steps. Both use the connector URL above.
connect.command: claude mcp add --transport http glow-prow https://api.glow-prow.top/api/mcp
connect.codeBlockTitle: Or add a remote MCP server in your client config:

workbuddy: Open WorkBuddy, go to Connectors / MCP settings.
Click Add Custom Connector, set type to HTTP / Streamable HTTP.
Paste the Chinese Optimized Endpoint URL (.../api/mcp/zh).
Click Connect / Authenticate, sign in to your Glow Prow account and allow access.
In your chat, query weapons or loadouts directly; the model will automatically invoke the tools.
claude: Open Claude settings, go to Connectors.
Name it Glow Prow and paste the connector URL above.
Click Add, then Connect, and approve access on Glow Prow.
In a chat, click + and enable the Glow Prow connector for that conversation.
claudeCode: Run the command below in your terminal (add --scope user to use it across projects).
Run /mcp, select glow-prow and sign in.
chatgpt: Enable developer mode in Settings, then go to Security & login.
Name it Glow Prow, choose Public endpoint and paste the connector URL.
Create it, then sign in with your Glow Prow account when prompted.
grok: Visit grok.com/connectors and click New connector.
Choose Custom and paste the connector URL.
Sign in with your Glow Prow account.
other: Any assistant that supports remote MCP connectors with login works.
Add a remote (HTTP) MCP server in your client using the connector URL above.
When the client requests authorization you will be redirected to the Glow Prow website to sign in and allow access.

manifesto.title: Shining Prow was born here ——————
manifesto.p1: In the endless ocean of games, every player is an adventurer sailing alone. Ahead is the unknown mist, behind is the track of exploration.
manifesto.p2: Shining Prow is not just a decoration on the bow, but the light that pierces through the mist. When you are lost, it is the lighthouse that illuminates the path ahead; when you are confused, it is the wisdom that deciphers the puzzles.
manifesto.p3: We believe that every game is a world waiting to be explored, and every player deserves the clearest guidance. Shining Prow gathers community wisdom, refines practical tools, and turns them into eternal starlight to accompany your every voyage. From the initial glimmer to today's beacon, we have always held a single belief: serving the voyagers and guiding the explorers.

portal.portraitDescription:
{name} is a fan-made wiki, guide and data collection site for Skull and Bones, built by players for players — free to browse, no login required.
Here you can look up ships, weapons, armor, furniture, materials, commodities, cosmetics, sets and collectibles, complete with loot sources, crafting recipes and stats.
The fully collected interactive map marks every resource node, settlement, chest and shipwreck, with category filters and custom markers to keep your exploration on course.
You can share your ship builds and use the material calculator to break down crafting costs and plan farming routes.
Questlines, empire skills, masteries, seasonal events and the Smuggler's Report are all kept up to date with every patch.
May these charts help you rule the seas.

invalidCode.q: The code is always rejected. What should I do?
invalidCode.a: Make sure automatic time sync is enabled on both your phone and computer, then enter the code currently shown in the authenticator. If it still fails, check that the correct account is selected in the app.

recovery.a: If your authenticator is lost, replaced, or unavailable, a recovery code can be used instead of the dynamic code to sign in. Each code works only once, and the server stores hashes only, so they cannot be viewed again after leaving the page.

lostRecovery.q: What if I lose my recovery codes?
lostRecovery.a: After signing in, click Regenerate recovery codes to get a new set. All old codes are invalidated immediately, so keep the new ones safe.

newPhone.q: Can I still sign in after changing phones or reinstalling the app?
newPhone.a: Sign in with a recovery code first, then disable two-step verification and enable it again with the new key. If you still have a backup of the old key, you can also enter it manually on the new device.

trust.q: What does Trust this computer do?
trust.a: If checked on the sign-in form, this browser can sign in without a code for 7 days. Do not check it on public computers. The option only appears on the sign-in page.

setupExpired.q: The setup session expired halfway through.
setupExpired.a: The setup token is valid for only 10 minutes. Click Enable Two-Step Verification again to generate a new QR code and recovery codes.

rules.repeatDesc: Repeat subscriptions can level up your tier. For example, subscribing to Apprentice Pirate twice adds 1.0x quota multiplier; subscribing to Helmsman 5 times reaches 3.0x. The active count is displayed after tier names in the list (up to 10 times per tier).
